observations: body L1-L3: the end of Schiaparelli's addition to the note a) on chapter 12, begun on p. 185; it closes with a heavy bracket after his name in small capitals.
body L4: in the head, the dash of «16–22» measures 5.4 pt, the dash between «37» and «pag. 26», set with spaces, 4.7 pt; transcribed as a long dash and a hyphen.
body L6: «Est- West» is printed with a hyphen (3.2 pt) and a space after it; kept as printed.
body L11: the dash of «al-Battānī» measures 3.5 pt, a hyphen; in L16 and L26 the name is letter-spaced with the long dash (5.5 pt).
body L20-L23: Schiaparelli's explanation of the corrupt words stands in heavy brackets, as in the addition of L1-L3.

body L22-L27: the formulas are checked. The proportion EC : CG = EM : GF = CM : CF gives EM = GF × EC / CG; with EC = sin amplit. ortivae, GF = sin altit. merid. and CG = EC + EG = sin amplit. ortivae + cos altit. merid. it is rule (α). With R = 1, sin amplit. ortivae = sin δ / cos φ, sin altit. merid. = cos (φ − δ) and cos altit. merid. = sin (φ − δ), the denominator cos φ sin (φ − δ) + sin δ equals sin φ cos (φ − δ), so that the altitude on the prime vertical is sin δ / sin φ, as it must be.
body L24: the cedilla under the C of «Cum» and the hook under the C of «EC» are spots of ink; they are not signs.
body L31, L33: the minus signs are printed as long dashes; they are set as minus signs.
body L33: the large parentheses enclose the fraction with its compound denominator, as printed.
